import pulp

prob = pulp.LpProblem("minimize_time", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
boat_trips = pulp.LpVariable("boat_trips", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # boat trips
canoe_trips = pulp.LpVariable("canoe_trips", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # canoe trips

# Objective: minimize total time
prob += 20 * boat_trips + 40 * canoe_trips

# Constraints
prob += 10 * boat_trips + 8 * canoe_trips >= 300  # 300 ducks
prob += boat_trips <= 12  # at most 12 boat trips
prob += 0.6 * (boat_trips + canoe_trips) >= 0.6 * 300  # at least 60% by canoe
prob += boat_trips + canoe_trips >= 300 / 10  # at least 30 ducks per trip

prob.solve(pulp.getSolver("HiGHS", msg=False))
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[prob.status])
print("Objective:", pulp.value(prob.objective))
print("boat_trips =", pulp.value(boat_trips))
print("canoe_trips =", pulp.value(canoe_trips))
